clips.title: The story
paras: In the Valley of Trials, Etched Parchment calls a young hunter to Jen'shan. Gornek delivers it after the initiate's first blooding, opening the way to wilderness training in Durotar.

After proving themselves against mottled boars, hunters in the Valley of Trials receive an etched parchment from Gornek. Jen'shan, a skilled Darkspear hunter, sent the note after watching new arrivals from the edges of the encampment. It welcomes the initiate to formal training and recognizes the instincts needed to master Durotar's untamed beasts and harsh land.

Reporting to Jen'shan marks the move from recruit to dedicated stalker. She warns that hunting is no easier than the arcane arts or ancestral shamanism. Mastering Durotar's predators, maintaining ranged weapons, and surviving on unforgiving land all demand discipline. Jen'shan sends her apprentices to aid the valley's other inhabitants and test their abilities before returning to learn more advanced survival techniques.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, friend.
Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the adventurer trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, so you come at last. Good. Jen'shan be waitin' for you.
Many tink it be an easy path, but Jen'shan tell you dat not true. Mastering da beasts of Durotar and beyond take as much skill as masterin' the arcane arts or speakin' to our ancestors.
Firin' a bow or rifle may not be as dangerous to you as castin' a spell, but it sure be as dangerous to your enemy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: When we finish speakin', you should talk to da rest of da citizens in da Valley. They ask you to do tings for them... Tings that will test your skill and teach you some of da dangers of this land.
As you grow in experience and wisdom, you be needin' Jen'shan to show you better techniques and skills. Come back to Jen'shan often. I will let you know what I can teach you.
